balls.text: Another slower ball... ends the innings! Very full, just outside off. Mohsin clears the front leg and tries to jam it into the ground. Gets an edge that floats to short third. All smiles and high-fives among Ngidi and Axar

Nortje's into the shot too early, goes through with it. Long-off takes it. Pitched right up, just outside off. Nortje wound up big, took a small, straight stride and tried to munch a lofted drive down the ground.
Dipping slower ball is full outside off, driven to deep cover
Slower one into the pitch outside off, Shahbaz goes too hard for the cut. Misses
Right up, taken at cover point. Low full toss swerving away towards the base of off stump. Shami cleared the front leg and looked to go over cover. Got it off the bottom of the bat
Very short outside off, 133ks, pulled into the ground. Goes to deep midwicket
Yorker outside off, squeezed to deep midwicket

That rockets... straight to Miller at long-off! That was travelling at pace, very flat, Miller must've been taken aback. He was a few feet in the ropes, was leaning back as the ball came, then took it reverse-cupped. Took a step or two back as he got carried by the momentum. Was a slot ball in the hitting range, Samad drove it hard with a full follow-through
Looks to slog the full ball, gets it off the bottom of the bat to long-on
Turns it to deep square leg
Full on leg, flicked through the leg side of the pitch. Ngidi charges but can't stop the single
Length outside off, wipes it to short third. Wants the single, not on
Dipping low full toss on off, Samad's upper body falls forward as he flicks it through square leg
Slower one leads to a French cut. Looked to defend to cover, got it to short fine leg. Ngidi going fuller side of length just outside off
Around the wicket, but width given. Back of length, there for Shahbaz to stand tall and carve it over backward point
Slower one on a length just outside off, punched towards cover. Ngidi changing his direction - to the left - as he jumps before delivering
Length on leg, flicked to deep square leg. 89ks. Kuldeep seen off, he ends with a two-for
Wide and full, slapped to long-off
Fullish ball on leg, flicked towards deep midwicket. Axar charges in and throws it to the keeper, but Samad was the one running in from the other end while Shahbaz stood his ground
Length just outside off, goes back and on one leg. Punches it to deep point
Length on middle, driven to long-off
Looks to thump the full ball coming in wide of long-on, gets it to him instead
Fullish on leg, 132ks, flicked to long leg. Timeout taken
Pitched right up, punched to long-off
Change of length, he's ready for it! Missed yorker, and the low full toss is bashed from just outside off. Clean swing, upper-body springing back as he drove it straight
Clobbered! This is length-picking. Natarajan's lost some pace, Samad can camp in the crease for the length ball to arrive and wallops it with a closed bat face over midwicket
Goes across to off stump, gets inside the line of the length ball and flicks to deep square leg
Length just outside off, guided to backward point's right. Good tumbling stop from Kuldeep
Length on fourth, goes back and drives to cover
A bit of width on that length ball. Might've been a googly, spun away. Cut to point
Shorter side of length on leg, goes back and flicks it away to deep midwicket's left. Great running to get two
Goes back and square drives with the spin. Rolls to deep point
Almost carries to cover! Delightful flight again, 80ks, length ball just outside off. Shahbaz was also too early into the punch to cover, bottom hand came off

Leading edge lollipops back to the bowler 87ks stock ball on a fullish length, Choudhary got his weight forward and tried to nudge it to the leg side. Closed the bat-face too early. Kuldeep didn't have to move much
Slower one just outside off, the fullish ball is driven with a flourish, to long-off
Pitched up outside off, driven to long-off
Uses the pace even though it's a slower ball. The shortish ball bounced a lot, around head-height. Angling away outside off. Samad went for the upper cut, got it off the edge. Beats short third
Excellent yorker. Samad was sliding off side but was stopped in his tracks. Tried to jam it straight, got an inside edge that landed and popped behind
Shortish outside off, cut without full power. Deep point runs left to keep it to two
Length just outside off, goes across to off and stays behind as he punches to backward point
Pitched up on off, driven to cover's right. Good diving stop to the right. 93ks. Vipraj gets out of the over well
Driven nicely, beats short cover. Deep cover runs left and stops it. Length ball just outside off
Goes back, stays beside the length ball on middle. Flicked to deep midwicket
Shortish on leg, pulled to deep square leg. Samad wound himself proper, wanted another boundary there
This might be the break-free over. Proper long-hop, ample time to adjust to the turn away, and then pulls it between deep square leg and deep midwicket
Lots happening in the action, ball does too much. Length just down leg, beats the flick and tickles the pad. Too quick for the keeper
Uppish, lands and goes to the bowler. Fullish on middle, didn't come on to the bat. Mukul got forward and was into the forward punch too early. Back to the bowler
Length on leg, punched off the back foot to long-on. 95ks
Lot of width on that length ball, cut to deep point
Axar runs right and denies the single. Slinger pitched fullish on leg, worked off the front foot
At the stumps, just a touch fuller than the last one. Clipped with a nice follow-through to long-on
Length outside off, flat, punched to cover
Quick single to cover's left. Length ball just outside off, punched defensively
Through everyone. Given runs. Not sure how the edge on the sweep went over the keeper but it does. Kuldeep giving it air and going full
Paddles it fine first ball. Took the front leg well outside off and leant across early, was behind the length ball and played it delicately

Kuldeep's been floating it up, has taken a few big hits... and now he bears fruit! It's slow as ever through the air, and just spins away from the batter and is closer to him than Marsh might have accounted for. It was a googly, too. Marsh's bat twists in his hand and he mistimes this in the air. Stubbs pouches this at mid-off
Kuldeep pushes this closer to the batter, but still outside off. Marsh reaches for this and defends this late, straight to backward point
Marsh latches onto this one with panache! Floated up, outside off, and there to be hit. Marsh gets on his legs and just swipes this across the line. Disappears over the cow corner boundary

The big-hitting Samad is almost rattled first up. Another slowwww one, somehow sneaks past Samad on the front foot, trying to flick this away. Big appeal for an LBW, umpire says no, they review... Pitching outside off, impact in line, but wickets missing, as looked likely even at first glance

That's almost vintage Bravo, but somehow better! Ball of the tournament so far, really. Pooran goes on the front foot, trying to play this full ball down into the off-side. But Ngidi has disguised his off-cutter to perfection. It floats through the air, impossibly slow, and somehow, sneaks past Pooran's bat and rattles his stumps. Magical T20 bowling, this
On a full length, and Marsh stays back in his crease to glide this towards deep point

And now Marsh regains his timing, and how! The ball is on a good length again, straight at the stumps. Marsh swings at it with an impeccably straight bat. Hold the pose once more, please. Over the ropes and the waiting fielder who tries to lunge at it, to no avail
Slow and kept outside off, Marsh tries to drive this late but gets no timing on it
Ngidi floats this outside off. Pooran leans into a drive away from his balance, but times this perfectly as it dribbles away towards deep extra cover
On a length. Marsh gets on the backfoot and defends this right back at the bowler
Too straight, right on the stumps. Gets on his knees and sweeps this finer, into deep fine leg boundary now
On a good length now, just outside leg. Spins back into him and he tucks this off his hips and towards square leg
Still slow, and kept even more outside off. Pooran waits just that extra second before sweeping it towards deep mid-wicket
Smart comeback from Kuldeep! Slows it down. Pooran gets on his knees for another sweep, but misses as the ball slowwws past him
And there's the classic Pooran slog sweep! So smooth with it. Bowled on a perfectly okay length outside off. Pooran down on his knees in a flash and just rifles this into the deep square boundary
Kept outside off and skids off the pitch. Marsh goes for a huge hoick with fixed feet once more, but swishes at air
On a length and kept outside off. Pooran drives this towards the covers
Bowled full-ish, just outside off. Pooran is quick to get down at this ball and defend it towards mid-off

Badoni departs without scoring! Natarajan angles this away from the batter after landing it on a length, outside off. Badoni has no idea how to play at that as he just goes for a wild slow, and KL collects behind the stumps
On a full length, just outside off. Badoni drives it to covers
Marsh gets no timing on this as he goes for another hoick. Outside off and back of a length, Marsh reaches for this and slashes it, but it drills into the pitch and goes to point
Badoni begins with a solid defense towards mid-off. Ball was bowled on a length and outside off, and he had plenty of time to get on the front foot with this one

Now THAT'S a comeback! Axar bowls this one quicker, pulls back the length and pushes it to the off stump line. Markram goes for another big swing after opening up his front foot. But the ball rifles through to the stumps and lights up the bails
And now Markram establishes his authority! The ball comes right under his eyes, too full. Markram swings at this and it's drilled over the ropes right in front of him
Marsh gets bat on this one, at least. Drifting down leg and he smashes this across the line... But straight to square leg

Now that's a beauty from Axar! Drops this close to the batter after flighting it through the air. Spins in, and beats Marsh's inside half of the bat. And KL Rahul misses it too, so it goes to the boundary
97 clicks, slows through the air and Marsh is on his feet for a huge sweep through the air. But misses the line and thuds into his body
On a length and swings in from outside off. Markram times this sweetly as he drives, but the ball goes straight to mid-off inside the ring
Pulls it back to a good length again, moving into Markram. Goes for a drive but edges this into his pads instead
On a fuller length and right on the pads once more. Marsh gets cramped a little as he drives this towards mid-on once more
Mukesh returns to his good length delivery, just a little down leg. Marsh drives this down to mid-on but can't get it past the fielder
Mukesh tries to counter him by bouncing it right into the pitch. But it sails wayyyy over Marsh's head. Time to reload

Classy! Marsh counters Mukesh by just taking a step down the pitch. It's enough for him to meet this ball full. A lofted straight drive, right down the ground, and he holds the pose as the ball sails over the ropes

Mukesh goes up in a roar! The ball dropped back of a length, and swung right into Marsh's pads. He got no bat on it as he just swung across the line. Runs away towards the deep third boundary, a tad unlucky for Mukesh but Marsh will take this
Impeccable timing! On a length and outside off, as it has been all over. Except Markram is on the back foot in a flash and just covers this into the covers boundary
Pitched fuller, closer to the stumps too. Marsh is more than happy to just drive this towards mid-off
Outside off, on a good length. Marsh happy to continue the trend of this over and defend it towards mid-off
On a length once more. Markram stays in his crease and flicks this into the mid-wicket zone and takes off for the other end of the pitch
Gets more width now, he goes on the backfoot and cuts this straight to point
Floats it up, and drops right in front of Markram. Defended down the pitch

MUKESH IS RUNNING OFF, Tahir-style! What's happened here!? Marsh drills a drive off a good length straight down the pitch. Too straight, in fact, because Mukesh gets a hand on it and the ball ricochets into the stumps. Pant is out of his crease, and what an unfortunate way to be dismissed...
On a length, swinging away from Pant. He plays this towards long leg without much force behind the shot, and jogs through for a single
Same length but strays onto his pads. Marsh flicks this under his head, towards deep square leg, and will be glad to get off the strike
Marsh goes for a drive and ends up French-cutting himself! The ball lands full, close to his feet. He drives it and the ball dribbles behind him, towards fine leg instead
Bowls it slower, around 135.6 clicks. Marsh tries to glide it behind him too, but backward point collects
Pitches full and swings away from the left-hander. He drives this down to mid-off and takes off for a quick run
Pant finds some width outside off, from a good length. He plays this late and glides this towards backward point to retain the strike
Ngidi is correcting his earlier error with a fuller line here, gives no width once more. Pant defends this into the leg side and Ngidi collects
Full and just driven down to mid-on
Too short, too wide once more. Marsh is deep in his crease and he lofts this over covers with ease. It's always running away to the ropes after that
Bowls it fuller and keeps it more tucked into the off stump line too. Swings back at Marsh, who defends
You bowl it there, I spank it through covers. Too short, gives width outside off, and Marsh stands still to just drill this to the deep cover boundary
Bowled on a great length, where it lands in front of Pant and then takes an exaggerated swing away from him, off the pitch. Pant tucks his bat towards him and it's been a good start for DC
Tries innovation, finds empty air! He shuffles into the leg side and tries to scoop this into his leg side. Slight appeal but no bat on that one
Bowls it quite wide. The ball swings away and Pant is happy to just watch it drift past him
Good comeback! Pulls the line shorter, Mukesh also swings it into Pant. The batter hunches as he defends awkwardly, down the pitch
Pant shows why he's batting up top! Mukesh bowls it full, too full, and right under Pant's eyes. A checked drive pushed down to long-on and he's collected a classy four first up
Strays down the leg side. On the fuller side once more, some decent swing in it but strikes Pant's pads and dribbles down to the diving KL with his gloves on
Pitched full and just outside off. Driven to covers without much power in the shot first up
Final ball as it turns out. Long-hop just outside off is hauled over deep midwicket with a pull. Rizvi smiles and punches Stubbs' arms as they hug
Back of length just outside off, punched to cover
That deserved more than one. Crunched the cover drive with one foot in front of leg stump and the other well down leg. Full ball hit from around middle
Makes room again, Nortje goes for the full ball just outside off. Rizvi's too far away and looks to scythe it behind point, loses his balance a bit and gets beaten
Makes room, Nortje looks to follow him with a bumper but it's too short and beats the keeper too. Rizvi looked to ramp it over the keeper, needed no contact in the end
Slower full ball on middle is defended softly to mid-on
Hostile pace meets incredible strokeplay! No using the pace business. Stubbs stands tall and flat bats a 144ks back of length ball from just outside off. Clears long-on for an 81-metre six
Length on off, punched off the back foot to cover
Hard length on off, defended to the bowler's left
More ready for this. Slower one halfway down the pitch. At the stumps. Pulled flat over deep square leg. That's the game all but done. Hundred partnership up
Bouncer has been helped fine with a pull, close to deep fine leg - who is fine - but beats him. Rizvi's head was going down and he crouched a touch as he played the shot.
Pace off, short of length, helped to fine leg

Might be out, no. Too far back for mid-off. Badoni ran to his right but the and the ball fell well forward. Was a back of length ball just outside off that Rizvi looked to pull across. Got opened up fully
Length at the stumps, punched to long-on
Back of length outside off, guided off the back foot to deep third
Back of length on off, flicked to midwicket
French cut goes to the fine-leg boundary. Back of length just outside off, seam-up and it decks back in, Stubbs is on the back foot looking to square-drive it, gets an under-edge
Thats audacious, making room to Nortje before he delivers. Back of length ball over middle is cut hard to deep cover point
Beaten. Went to ramp it over the keeper. Limboed to the leg side and got the bat up, the bouncer over him beat him for pace
Back of length on middle, flicked to deep-backward square
Length on off, defended to cover. Timeout taken
Compensation in line, Rizvi's ready and crunches a late cut to the left of backward point. Gets to fifty, raises his bat and gets applauded by the dugout

Rizvi meddles with Markram's line by sliding leg side, Markram misses his length too. Goes too full. Rizvi is perfectly placed for the step-hit. Drives it with a closed face, over wide long-on for a big six. We'll need a ball replacement
This'll all be at the body and a touch short, it seems like. Rizvi goes back and guides it to short fine leg
Markram bowling to the field but that's a touch too far down leg, shortish ball is pulled to the right of deep-backward square. Longish chase for the fielder
Back of length on leg, flicked through midwicket
Very low full toss at 136ks on middle and leg is flicked to long-on's right
Flashes it away, shot similar to the one that got Rahul. This goes wide of deep third, Mohsin dives to the right to save two. Full ball outside off, looking to drive over cover
Length on middle and leg, 136ks, looks to tuck it leg side. Gets a leading edge that goes into ground, to cover
Length on off, flicked to long-on
Length on off, guided with an open-faced vertical bat to deep third
Beats the edge. On a length, slightly wide, goes away and beats the attempted dab to third
Back of length on leg, looked slow off the pitch and it was indeed a slower one. 118ks. Rizvi swivelled as the ball was released, went for the pull. Didn't middle it, gets it to square leg
A bit of room and it's cut hard, finds backward point. Rizvi'll feel he missed out
Short on middle and off, pulled to deep midwicket
Wide, short too. Let go

Comes back in and beats the inside edge. Seam up 138ks length ball lands around middle and finishes on middle and off. Stubbs doesn't move his feet and is almost dangling the bat as he tries to defend straight
Length on off, open-faced punch off the back foot with a vertical bat. Goes to backward point on the bounce
And it's a comfy single to deep third. Length ball around off, Rizvi opens the face fully and looks back as ball hit bat
Back of length on middle and leg, 147ks, flicked to midwicket
Good short ball over middle and off, Rizvi squats down fully to let it pass. 148ks
Shortish 145ks ball on off. Stubbs too jumps a bit while playing this. Gets his gloves away from the ball while defending towards cover point
Length on off, defended while jumping back to cover
Pitched up outside off, punchy drive through cover. Deep point runs right to stop it
On off stump, the length ball is flicked to deep square leg
Poor over, smart batting! Now it floated down leg, and he just flicks it towards deep fine leg to collect another boundary
A long hop, really. Rizvi goes on the backfoot and just slashes this across the line. Runs towards the deep square leg area, which lies vacant
On a length, right on the stumps, Stubbs drives this past a diving Axar Patel - who almost does a cartwheel - and towards long off
On a length. He drives this down through the mid-off area
Great shot, this! Gets on one knee and hoicks this ball from its short-ish length and behind him, into the deep fine leg boundary
Slow through the air, lands on a length in front of the stumps. Rizvi flicks this towards deep mid-wicket
A boundary after a while! Shami pitches this slightly fuller, outside off, and he drives this towards the covers. Stands tall and times this with elegance, he's done well to stay in the middle here
Almost gets the nick! Ball lands on a length, then straightens after pitching. Whizzes past a Stubbs defense, he knows he's lucky to survive that
Full and on the stumps, driven down to mid-on once again
On a length and a grounded shot gets Stubbs to the other end
Another bouncer. Rizvi plays this almost like a tennis forehand, because the ball was drifting right down his head. Slapped with a bat perpendicular to the pitch, and straight down the ground
On a length, on the stumps, Stubbs drives this towards mid-on and jogs to the other end
And that's why the extras hurt. Another short ball, outside off this time. Rizvi does really well to lean back and ramp this over deep third
Oh lord. Another bouncer attempted that drifts down leg. Wideeeeee.
On a length outside off. It's drop and run once again, as Stubbs plays this into the pitch and sprint to the other end of the pitch
On a length again, outside off. Rizvi times the pants out of this drive, but extra cover runs to his right to intercept this
Good ball, on a length and just outside off. Rizvi does well to glide this quite late, towards deep backward point
W-i-d-e. Wide. It was a wide. Drifts away from the batter looking to hook this short ball, down leg.
Full and swinging back into the pads of Rizvi. An attempt at a flick never goes anywhere
Too wide, back of a length. Stubbs easily threads this through to the deep cover region
Fuller now, outside off. An energetic cut gets it down to point. They do well to save the extra run, not so well to throw in a wayward ball. They sneak in a second run. Not good fielding, in the end
Another wide, how we'd missed those! Goes for another bouncer, but the batter jumps for it and still can't reach it
French cut. On a good length, rising at him as he tries to drive it. Ball dribbles down to backward square leg, lying vacant, as they sneak in a run
On a length and tailing into the batter. Flicks this from near his chest, towards square leg
Well outside off. Stubbs plays this inside-out drive late, towards deep point
And he's finally off the mark! On a length, right outside off, he plays it towards mid-off and runs over to the other end. Finally!

Rizvi's agony continues. He tries to change his fortunes by stepping down the pitch and swinging through the line. The ball is on a length on the stumps, and it just whizzes past him. Appeals around the pitch, umpire says not out. We have ourselves a review. Big gap between bat and ball, it seems. Rizvi's now seven balls without a run on the board...
Shorter now, rising at Stubbs outside off. Stubbs flicks this towards deep fine leg and sets off for the other end
On a length, right on the line of the stumps, Stubbs is happy to just defend once more
Awkward flash at the ball as he tries to swipe across the line from in front of his chest. Short-ish, but slows down, and thuds into him instead of producing any runs
Rizvi tries to play this late, but still can't get off the mark. Outside off, still getting vicious swing off it, and he glides this straight towards backward point
Same delivery: outside off, on a length, and driven to the covers
On a length, defended again
Good ball - on a length, on the off-stump line, and Stubbs can only defend it down the pitch once more
Full and outside off. Stubbs drives this into the covers...
Well-directed bouncer, but no venom to it. Stubbs stands still and just swats this away from sight. Ball rushes towards deep square leg

WHAT A BALL! Timbersssss. Prince Yadav bangs this in on a length, swings back into Axar. 138.3 kph, but felt more like 148.3 off the pitch. Axar tried to flick this and is in disbelief as he turns around and sees his stumps splattered. Whaddaball
Bouncer. Sprayed down leg side though. Wide. Kapiche?

Straight up and Pant collects this one! Was on a length, just outside off. Nissanka never looked comfortable out there. Slogs this high in the air, behind him, and Pant dives in the end to complete the catch
Bangs it in short. Too wide. Called a wide. There's been a lot of wides. You get the idea
135.4 clicks, looks slower off the pitch. Kept on a length outside off, Nissanka goes cross-batted but can only find mid-wicket
Sprayed well outside off. Takes late swing, but umpire spreads his arms again
Slightly fuller, kept right on the off stump line and the batter is rushed just a little as he defends this under his eyes
On a length, swinging away after landing on the stumps. Easy defense into the off side
Full-ish, on his pads. Rizvi flicks this towards deep fine leg and takes an easy run. Gets an easier second one as a result of a sloppy misfield from Pant...

Samad gets it on second try! Rana tries to glide this laaaateee. The ball was on a length, seaming away. Took the edge off his shot - still, what was he thinking trying to play it late with first slip right there? Samad goes for it, ball bounces in the air, then he pouches it safely
Angled into his hips off a good length, Nissanka runs into his leg side and when he sees the ball is seaming into him, he flicks this towards backward square leg
On a length and swings away from the batter from an outside off line. A loose waft in the air, honestly, goes back to the keeper
On a length outside off, more cramped lines, less swing into the batter. Rises at Rana's gloves as he defends this with some unease

Rana gets hold of that one! Shami attempts a similar delivery, angling it into his hips from outside off. Rana uses the angle into him to flick this into the air, off his hips. Runs away to the deep square boundary
Finally, a full ball. Big angle back into the batter off a good length, outside off. Rana defends it down the pitch
Shami bangs it in short again, 137.9 clicks this time. He angles it right at the batter too this time, so Rana crouches below it
Goes short again, bounces away, wide of Rana. He reaches for it but gets no ball on bat once more
Banged in short, drifts past Pant. Not short enough to be called wide, so turns out to be a good defensive delivery
Goes wide again. Angled away from the batter, and springs away from the wide marker too. He's missing his lines here
He corrects his line to right on the pads. Rana goes on the front foot to flick it towards mid-wicket and take off for a well-judged run
Prince drifts definitely down leg now. No shot batter reaches that. Umpire spreads his arms, time to reload
Prince goes fuller again. But too straight on the pads, there to be hit. Goes for the flick but misses, sees the ball go to Pant
On the stumps once more but it's too short. Rises at Rana's chest and he swivels on his feet to hit across the line, into the deep square boundary
Prince is keeping his lines really tight. Good length, on the stumps, Rana can only bring his bat down the defend it to cover
Great bowling! A tad of swing, but it's just the bounce off a good length at 140 clicks. Rises into Rana's hips and thuds in there
On a good length, just outside off. Driven from deep into the crease and towards deep point, who collects right where he stands
On a great length, on the stumps too. Swings away from the batter and Rana shoulders arms
A great bouncer, this! Pitches outside off and rises at the batter as it moves right into his helmet. Ducks out of the way at the last moment

Rana finally makes use of the width Shami keeps offering up. Barely any swing or venom on this one. Rana anticipates it, and slashes at it well away from his body. Rushes down to the deep point boundary
Bowls it fuller now, angles into Rana once more from outside off. Confident defensive drive down to mid-off
And now Shami angles it in. Back of a length, moves back in to hit Rana on the pads, who misses a flick
Shami is keeping it wide for some reason. Swings away after pitching, but Rana happy to see the ball drift far away from him
Shami bangs this in full and right on the wide marker. A big whoosh from Rana as he plays at it, but plays at air. In fact, the umpire's signaled a wide
Gone straight away! Shami pitches this full, outside off. Rahul goes for an extravagant inside-out cover drive, but mistimes it straight to deep point
